## Capabilities
- Ed25519-signed claim envelopes (trust/1.0)
- SHA-256 hash chain from GENESIS, publicly walkable
- zero-trust Node verifier (verify.js, zero dependencies)
- machine-readable achievements feed (achievements.json)
- per-claim human-readable proof pages (claims/*.html)

- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
